notes: D1 oracle is ruter.no T-bane linjekart (line map) and current timetables, HAND-TRANSCRIBED per the oracle report. Not generated from GTFS.
City stays planned. Modes v1: TRAIN-like T-bane (Sporveien T-banen, operating on contract from Ruter) lines 1-5 only. Tram (trikk), bus, Vy/NSB commuter rail, and Line 6 (Fornebu) are out of v1.
Timezone Europe/Oslo HAS DST (CET/CEST, UTC+1 standard / UTC+2 summer). Standard EU DST transition dates assumed; no Oslo-specific dates given in the oracle report.
Norwegian characters (ø, å, Ø, Å) preserved in both D1 print forms and Entur GTFS stop_name. Do not ASCII-fold anywhere in the pipeline.
Hub lock: Stortinget. All five T-bane lines serve it; report calls it 'kilometer zero' of the network; located beneath the Storting (Parliament). Do not fragment this label by line.
Secondary transfer hub: Tøyen (all five lines converge; street-level interchange). Not a singular lock like Stortinget — handle as interchange, not a fragment/collapse point.

doNotGroup: Jernbanetorget T-bane (metro, in-tunnel) vs Oslo Central Station / Oslo S / Jernbanetorget railway station (Vy/NSB, above ground) vs street-level bus/tram terminals at the same square. All occupy Jernbanetorget square but are separate transport products.

Line 6 (Fornebu) is under construction, opening expected 2029. Not D1-live. Blindern (a Line 6 branch station) and any other Line-6-only station are intentionally NOT inserted. A new D1 flip is required after Fornebu opens.

gtfsRouteIdsIfKnown are the passenger line numbers (1-5) per the oracle report's H2 table (Entur GTFS route_short_name 1-5, route_type=1/subway). No stopIds in this file, matching reference-city convention of not sourcing station identity from GTFS.
ET-Client-Name header required on all Entur endpoints (GTFS-RT and GraphQL). It is an identifying header, not a secret key — NLOD licence, no auth token needed.

doNotGroup: Oslo Central Station / Oslo S / Jernbanetorget railway station (Vy/NSB) — separate from Jernbanetorget T-bane metro stop
Street-level bus/tram terminals at Jernbanetorget square — separate product from the T-bane metro stop

commonTunnel.name: Fellestunnelen (Common Tunnel)
commonTunnel.note: The only fully ordered, fully sourced station sequence in the oracle report. Confirmed west-to-east order below. Do not extend this array past either end without a new hand-transcribed source.

coverageGaps: BLOCKER: full per-line station arrays (west of Majorstuen and east of Tøyen) for lines 1-5 were not hand-transcribed in the oracle report. Only the six shared Common Tunnel stations have a confirmed order. Do NOT infer full line topology, termini, or branch points from GTFS, from a generator, or from general/background knowledge of the Oslo T-bane network — that is exactly the silent station-graph mistake this pipeline exists to avoid. Needs a follow-up Nico pass against the Ruter linjekart before Jim can build direction-collapse logic beyond the shared tunnel.
No termini given for lines 1-5. Required before a line+terminus direction model (the recommended model; see direction-model-memo.md) can be written up as a D5 assertion table.

Known-but-unordered station facts from the oracle report, not placed in any sequence: Skøyen (served by lines 1 & 2, west of centre), Frogner (served by line 3, west of centre). Listed per-line below under knownAdditionalStations, NOT inserted into the ordered stations array.
Report gives no specific Ruter T-bane linjekart PDF/page URL — only the ruter.no homepage and app link generically as D1. A precise citable D1 map source URL is needed for future re-verification.
Line 6 (Fornebu) under construction, opening expected 2029. Blindern and any other Line-6-only station intentionally not inserted.
Tram (trikk), bus, Vy/NSB commuter rail, and transfers to non-metro modes are out of v1 oracle.
No stopIds in this file. gtfsRouteIdsIfKnown are the passenger line numbers only.
